game: Mega Man Battle Network 4: Red Sun (USA)
about: Addresses, names and descriptions only: facts about the ROM, read from Cyberworld Endless's own sources (src/emu/*.h, src/core/rom.c, docs/rom/). No graphics, text, sound or code of the game. See docs/rom/symbols.md.

docs/rom/bn4.md:38.title: Map tables
docs/rom/bn4.md:38.how: Verify: `build/host/cyberworld --headless --rom-dir DIR --atlas OUT:x1`, BN4 beside BN6 in DIR, draws every map with its walls, heights and triggers.

docs/rom/bn4.md:40.title: Songs
docs/rom/bn4.md:40.how: A table of song headers (tracks 0-16, a voice group pointer, a pointer per track) found by its shape; the same search finds BN5's at its known `0x155BF4`. 33 songs of four tracks or more, 0x00-0x21 but 0x0E: its music.

docs/rom/bn4.md:43.title: The encounter check and the roll
docs/rom/bn4.md:43.how: Verified in romlab: the check patched to `ldr r0,=record; bx lr` starts that battle from Lan's room (`tools/bn4_lab.py battle`).

docs/rom/bn4.md:44.title: Battle records
docs/rom/bn4.md:44.how: Verified in romlab: ACDC Area's third record (`0x08100168`, `--record 90:0:2`) fields Billy (50 HP) and a Mettaur (40) at its panels (5, 2) and (6, 3); a record written with enemy 7 at (4, 1) and 13 at (5, 2) fields VolGear (80 HP) and Billy (50) there; enemy 1 written with kind 5 is a rock.

docs/rom/bn4.md:45.title: Enemy records
docs/rom/bn4.md:45.how: Found by the HP read in romlab: battles forced with enemy 1, 3, 5 and 13 alone held 40, 100, 180 and 50 in one RAM word of the enemy's (`0x0203B27C` that time); the one table of the ROM with those at a fixed stride is this one. +0 element << 12 \| HP (BN6's first word's form: VolGear's `0x1050`, Fire, 80), +3 the kind (4 a virus, 8 a Navi), +4 the family or the Navi's number, +5 the version (0-5), +10 a u16 attack (Mettaur 10, Mettaur3 160). 120 viruses and 95 Navi records.

docs/rom/bn4.md:46.title: Chip records
docs/rom/bn4.md:46.how: BN6's getChip (bn6f) found in BN4 by its bytes, its literal this table.

docs/rom/bn4.md:47.title: Chip names
docs/rom/bn4.md:47.how: BN4's text spells letters and digits as BN6 and BN5 do (A `0x0B`, a `0x26`, digits from `0x01`); "annon" found by its letters' spacing, then Cannon.

docs/rom/bn4.md:48.title: Enemy names
docs/rom/bn4.md:48.how: Mettaur found as Cannon was: viruses 1-126 (Mettaur, MettEX, Mettaur2 and on), the Navis from 128, four entries each, Duo at 224, Bass and BassXX at 228-230, the DS forms 240-252; each name the enemy record of its id.

docs/rom/bn4.md:49.title: Battle backgrounds
docs/rom/bn4.md:49.how: Verified in romlab (`.build/bn4-bg/`, not kept): +5 = 0x10 and 0x03 drew two backgrounds, and 0x10 with its three tables' entries pointed at 0x03's drew 0x03's frame byte for byte; on 0x90:0 with +5 0xFF the same frame as +5 = 4.

docs/rom/bn4.md:52.title: Chip records' fields and Souls
docs/rom/bn4.md:52.how: Verified in romlab: with flags 0x14 and 0x19 set UNITE lit after AirShot, WindSoul its icon, and the used Souls' word (`0x0203BF88`) 4 after OK; with flag 0x14 alone UNITE stood grey.

symbols.name: BN4_ENCOUNTER_CHECK
symbols.description: the encounter check the map loop calls each frame (0x080053E6): on the net, its steps counted, a record rolled (BN4_ROLL), stored at BN4_GAMESTATE_RECORD and returned (0 none); a record returned starts its battle (0x080053F4). Patched to `ldr r0,=record; bx lr`, it starts that battle
